summary: Iteration 77 - Team & Vendor Management Testing Complete. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI components verified working including Team tab, Vendors tab, grouped assignee dropdown in Create Issue dialog, and reassign dropdown in Issue Detail drawer.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console) - same as iteration 76

tests: POST creates team member with name, role, phone, email, specialities
Team member has type='internal' and is_active=true by default
GET /team/{property_id} returns team with open_issues and total_resolved counts
GET /team/all returns team across all properties
PUT updates team member fields (role, specialities, is_active)
DELETE removes team member and verifies removal
POST creates vendor with company_name, contact_person, phone, email, specialities, hourly_rate, currency, notes
Vendor has type='external', is_active=true, rating=0 by default
GET /vendors/{property_id} returns vendors with open_issues, total_resolved, total_cost
GET /vendors/all returns vendors across all properties
PUT updates vendor fields (hourly_rate, specialities, is_active)
DELETE removes vendor and verifies removal
Returns combined list of internal team and external vendors
Internal assignees have: name, type='internal', role, specialities, open_issues
External assignees have: name (company_name), type='external', role='vendor', specialities, hourly_rate, open_issues
GET /assignees/all returns assignees across all properties

tests: PUT /issues/{id} with assigned_to updates assignment

Vendor's open_issues count increases when assigned

technician, supervisor, electrician, plumber, handyman, hvac_tech all accepted
Issues tab visible with Kanban/Table views
Team tab visible with team member cards
Vendors tab visible with vendor table
Preventive tab visible with recurring schedules
Analytics tab visible with stats and charts

tests: Team tab shows team members as cards
Cards display name, role, specialities, workload (open/resolved)

Dialog has: name input, role dropdown (Technician/Supervisor/Electrician/Plumber/Handyman/HVAC), phone, email, specialities tag input
Add Member button creates team member

frontend_vendors_tab.description: Vendors tab with vendor table and Add Vendor dialog

Table columns: Vendor, Contact, Specialities, Rate, Open, Resolved, Total Cost

frontend_create_issue_assignee_dropdown.description: Create Issue dialog assignee dropdown with grouped options
tests: Assignee dropdown shows 'Unassigned' option
Dropdown has 'INTERNAL TEAM' group label
Internal team members listed with open issue count (e.g., 'John Smith (2 open)')
Dropdown has 'EXTERNAL VENDORS' group label
External vendors listed with hourly rate and open count (e.g., 'ABC Plumbing — £75/h (1 open)')

critical_code_review_comments: Team and Vendor CRUD endpoints well-implemented with proper type field (internal/external)
Workload tracking (open_issues, total_resolved) correctly calculated via aggregation
Vendor total_cost correctly aggregated from assigned issues' actual_cost
Assignees endpoint properly combines team + vendors with all necessary fields for dropdown
Frontend Team tab displays cards with workload data
Frontend Vendors tab displays table with rate and performance metrics
Assignee dropdown correctly groups Internal Team and External Vendors with open issue counts
Issue Detail drawer reassign dropdown shows both team and vendor options
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 77 added Team & Vendor management to the Maintenance module. Team members use collection 'maintenance_team' with fields: id, property_id, name, role, phone, email, specialities[], is_active, type='internal'. Vendors use collection 'maintenance_vendors' with fields: id, property_id, company_name, contact_person, phone, email, specialities[], hourly_rate, currency, notes, rating, is_active, type='external'. The /assignees endpoint returns combined list with 'type' field for dropdown grouping. Team members have open_issues and total_resolved counts. Vendors also have total_cost calculated from aggregate. Frontend has 5 tabs: Issues, Team, Vendors, Preventive, Analytics. Create Issue dialog and Issue Detail drawer both have assignee/reassign dropdowns with grouped Internal Team and External Vendors.

mocked_apis.note: All team and vendor APIs are fully functional with MongoDB persistence
